name: Ganzhou Yihao New Materials Co., Ltd.
summary: Ganzhou Yihao New Materials Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, manufacture, and sale of electrolytic copper foils and electronic components in China and internationally. It offers copper foils for electronic circuits, aluminum-based copper-clad laminates, and printed circuit boards. The company's products are primarily used communication equipment, automotive electronics, new energy, consumer and communication electronics, consumer electronics, computers, industrial control, medical devices, defense and aerospace, servers and data centers, artificial intelligence, and others. Ganzhou Yihao New Materials Co., Ltd. was founded in 2003 and is based in Ganzhou, China.
